caption: The drawing features two views of a mechanical device consisting of a large wheel mounted on a sturdy rectangular green wooden frame. The wheel has eight spokes and is fitted with eight equally spaced, conical brass or bronze horns attached to its rim. The left view is a front elevation, showing the circular wheel and all eight horns radiating from the center. The wheel is supported by two angled wooden struts joined at the wheel's axle, which is centrally positioned on the frame. The right view is a side elevation, showing four horns along a vertical strip at the rim of the wheel, standing one above the other. A metal handle protrudes horizontally from the right side of the axle housing, implying manual operation to rotate the wheel. The frame in the side view has a pair of splayed legs for stability. The device is rendered in various shades of green for the wood, with metallic brown, bronze, or brass tones for the horns. The background is plain and off-white, with the name “David P. Willoughby” inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Altar Chimes
